question: Break down net sales by segment (Walmart U.S., Walmart International, Sam's Club) and say which segment grew fastest and which had the highest operating margin.

answer.summary: Walmart's FY2024 consolidated net sales were $642.64B [F00003], up 6.1% YoY [F00003]. By segment, Walmart U.S. generated $441.82B (68.8% of total) [F00958], Walmart International $114.64B (17.8%) [F00959], and Sam's Club $86.18B (13.4%) [F00960]. Walmart International grew fastest in FY2024 at +13.5% YoY ($100.98B -> $114.64B) [F00959], versus Walmart U.S. at +5.1% [F00958] and Sam's Club at +2.2% [F00960]. Walmart U.S. had the highest operating income at $22.15B [F00962] on $441.82B of net sales [F00958], versus Walmart International at $4.91B [F00963] and Sam's Club at $2.19B [F00964], so Walmart U.S. had the highest operating margin. This is consistent with management's statement that Walmart U.S. has historically had the highest gross profit as a percentage of net sales [T00090].

key_numbers.metric: Walmart International net sales growth FY2024

drivers: Walmart U.S. was the LARGEST CONTRIBUTOR TO THE CHANGE in FY2024 net sales, contributing $21.26B (+5.1%), 58% of the total change [F00958][F00979]
Walmart International contributed $13.66B (+13.5%), 37% of the total change [F00959][F00980]
Sam's Club contributed $1.83B (+2.2%), 5% of the total change [F00960][F00981]
Corporate And Support contributed $0.00, 0% of the total change [F00961][F00982]
risks_and_red_flags: Sam's Club growth decelerated sharply to +2.2% in FY2024 from +14.7% in FY2023 [F00960], with lower fuel sales due to deflation partially offsetting growth [T00478]
Walmart U.S. growth slowed to +5.1% in FY2024 from +6.9% in FY2023 [F00958]
Corporate And Support posted a negative operating income of -$2.24B in FY2024, down 56.2% YoY from -$5.12B [F00965]
Sam's Club has the lowest operating income ($2.19B) among the three reportable segments [F00964]
